causal_conclusion: Package-contents executable-path metadata is a materially stronger evidence source than package name/short-description lexical overlap for supplier recovery.
The zero-cost apt-file contents index surfaced all four known viable supplier families without candidate installation or execution.
Executable-path evidence alone is not a sufficient ranking rule: librsvg2-bin remained rank 79 and mediainfo rank 17 under the naive term-count evidence score.
The residual blocker is therefore not raw supplier availability. It is extracting directional/role semantics from executable-level evidence strongly enough to prioritize the correct operation.

repair_eligibility.reason: The diagnostic proves recall but not a sufficiently precise operation-ranking rule. Search existing command/manpage semantic metadata before inventing another ranking algorithm.

next_action.objective: Use existing zero-cost command/manpage metadata for the surfaced executable candidates to measure whether directional operation semantics can distinguish source→target transformations and inspection roles before changing runtime ranking.
